description: PCB spiral coils and planar-motor windings with an English / Simplified Chinese interface.
description_full: CoilForge creates configurable PCB spiral coils and planar-motor windings. The IPC plugin provides an English and Simplified Chinese interface. Requires KiCad 10.0 or later, an enabled IPC API server, and Python 3.10+ with tkinter. KiCad installs the kicad-python dependency in its managed plugin environment. First-time dependency setup requires network access or a preconfigured package mirror.
